text.en: Most pet owners praise Sherri for her kind demeanour, flexibility with scheduling, and willingness to assist on short notice. Clients who booked extended boarding stays appreciate her responsiveness and regular updates. However, one client reported a lack of professionalism and felt their boarding expectations were not met, though other reviewers describe a dependable and supportive coordinator.

Several clients appreciate that elderly cats and energetic pets receive loving attention, playtime, and treats during their boarding visits. One reviewer valued the option to keep their cat separated from other animals to minimise stress. In contrast, another owner complained that their cat was distressed and not kept isolated as promised, resulting in an unexpected pregnancy.

The majority of pet owners report smooth, stress-free boarding stays that allowed them to travel with genuine peace of mind. Clients mention that extended bookings were handled seamlessly with daily routines maintained. Nevertheless, one reviewer expressed severe dissatisfaction regarding animal supervision and aftercare, whereas others strongly recommend the sitting service.

q.en: What types of pet boarding are offered?

a.en: The service provides in-home overnight boarding and day care for both dogs and cats in West Phoenix.

q.en: Can pets stay for extended periods?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that long-term stays lasting several weeks or months were accommodated with flexible extensions.

q.en: Do owners receive photo updates during boarding?

a.en: Clients mention that photo updates were sent upon request to provide reassurance while owners were away.

q.en: Can medications be given during sitting visits?

a.en: Yes, the care provider administers oral medications and adheres to specialised feeding routines when requested.
